speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you please describe when these symptoms of gait and limb ataxia began and whether they have been getting progressively worse?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To help narrow down the cause, could you tell me if you have a history of alcohol use, and have you experienced any recent headaches, vision changes, or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab, I am concerned about the possibility of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).
